eventDescription: Set against the backgroup of surrounding farmland, 6 acres of garden dating from the early 1900s are waiting to be explored. An Arts & Crafts movement inspired garden room featuring Japanese maples, a woodland walk dashed with ferns and shrubs, and a walled garden and arboretum offer a relaxed, unfussy space to stretch legs and enjoy a thoughtfully landscaped space.

eventDescription: A charming 10 acre garden set in beautiful countryside in the heart of Devon. The extensively planted Gardens create an idyllic, peaceful setting with vast lawns, large lakes, ponds, bog gardens and various water features including its own waterwheel and mill, a paradise for swans, ducks, geese and endless other wildlife. This is a garden full of character and charm, a wonderful place for children of all ages to enjoy and explore...topped off with homemade cakes and tea.

eventDescription: Easy access footpaths are dotted across fifty acres of natural, species-rich wildflower meadows. With dozens of varieties of wild flowers and grasses, thousands of orchids from early June, and a haven for butterflies in July, this beautiful setting gives wildlife enthusiasts an opportunity to enjoy seasonal natural beauty, set against the stunning views of the Blackdown Hills. Open evenings run from early May until the end of June giving families the chance to picnic in a spectacular setting, or, with a small cafe onsite serving light lunches and Cream Teas, enjoy views over the Corry valley whilst sampling a homegrown cider or apple juice.

eventDescription: Amelia’s Flower Farm PYO is a relaxed seasonal outing where families can pick a brilliant bouquet of unusual, scented flowers for £24/bucket (for 20 stems). Wander through the farm's flowerbeds that burst with colour throughout the summer months, while children help, pick their own, visit the resident piglets, enjoy a cake or icecream, then burn off some energy in the play area or by taking a short walk towards the River Teign nearby.
